name: apex-client
description: Local bridge for ApexTunnel, proxying local traffic to the public internet.

scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-linux-x64,node18-win-x64 --output bin/apex-client
scripts.build:arm64: pnpm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-linux-arm64 --output bin/apex-client-arm64
scripts.build:termux: pnpm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --target node18-linuxstatic-arm64 --output bin/apex-termux

author: BraveraTech
